rounds.text: Exato Technologies Ltd is demonstrably under-appreciated by the market because its extraordinary fundamental momentum vastly outpaces the broader sector benchmarks [E6, E7, E11]. Compounded sales growth stands at a stellar 32% over 3 years and 35% over the trailing twelve months, while compounded profit growth has surged to 47% and 72% respectively [E14, E15, E16, E17]. This financial acceleration is further underscored by a stellar return on capital employed of 26.9% and a median return on equity of 25%, drastically outperforming sector medians [E10, E12, E13, E18, E56]. Furthermore, the company has actively strengthened its balance sheet by reducing its borrowings from Rs 32 Cr to Rs 21 Cr, resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.24x [E30, E28, E41]. Crucially, a disciplined discounted cash flow model places the intrinsic value at Rs 768 per share, offering a tangible margin of safety above the current market price of Rs 677 [E36, E37]. Conceded: the price-to-earnings multiple of 35.9x sits well above the sector benchmark of 21.34x [E1, E6].
